verdict.rationale: The docs confirm a built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, for automated workflows on hosted or private runners, with centralized visibility of pipeline status (docs-10, docs-18, docs-8). Nothing in the pack says pipelines are defined as code or in YAML, which is the heart of this story. Missing for 10: any evidence of a YAML pipeline syntax or config-as-code file, documentation of pipeline definition structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
